name: Jari Heikkinen
bio:
Jari's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for rally racing, fueled by the snowy landscapes of his native Finland. He started as a mechanic's apprentice, quickly demonstrating a keen eye for detail and an unwavering commitment to precision. His meticulous nature led him to specialize in quality control, where he has spent the last 15 years ensuring that every component meets the highest standards. 

Joining Academy Motorsport was a natural progression for Jari, offering him the opportunity to contribute to a team known for its dedication to excellence. He approaches his role with a pragmatic mindset, believing that thorough inspection and adherence to procedures are paramount to success on the track. His calm demeanor and ability to identify potential issues before they escalate make him an invaluable asset to the team. What sets Jari apart is his ability to simplify complex problems and implement practical solutions, earning him the respect of his colleagues and drivers alike.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: A stocky man with a focused gaze, Jari always seems to be observing every small detail.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Insists on double-checking all measurements, even if someone else has already done so.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on surfaces when deep in thought.
